description: Header file defining functions, data structures, and constants for tracking and collecting Zigbee events in a Zigbee event tracker module. It includes function declarations for adding events, collecting event data, and managing memory, as well as data structures representing various Zigbee event items.

methods.name: zigbeeEventTrackerAddAttributeReportEvent
methods.description: Adds attribute report for non-sensor devices into collection based on device UUID or EUI64.

methods.name: zigbeeEventTrackerAddRejoinEvent
methods.description: Adds a rejoin event for a device, including secure rejoin info.

methods.name: zigbeeEventTrackerAddClusterCommandEvent
methods.description: Adds a check-in or duplicate sequence number event for a device.

methods.name: zigbeeEventTrackerAddApsAckFailureEvent
methods.description: Records an APS acknowledgment failure event for a device.

methods.name: zigbeeEventTrackerAddDeviceFirmwareUpgradeSuccessEvent
methods.description: Increments count of successful device firmware upgrades.

methods.name: zigbeeEventTrackerAddDeviceFirmwareUpgradeFailureEvent
methods.description: Records a firmware upgrade failure for a device.

methods.name: zigbeeEventTrackerCollectAttributeReportEventsForDevice
methods.description: Returns a copy of attribute report events for a device, caller must free.

methods.name: zigbeeEventTrackerCollectRejoinEventsForDevice
methods.description: Returns a copy of rejoin events for a device, caller must free.

methods.name: zigbeeEventTrackerCollectCheckInEventsForDevice
methods.description: Returns a copy of check-in events for a device, caller must free.

methods.name: zigbeeEventTrackerCollectEventCountersForDevice
methods.description: Returns event counters for a device, caller must free.

methods.name: zigbeeEventTrackerCollectFirmwareUpgradeSuccessEvents
methods.description: Returns the number of successful firmware upgrades.

methods.name: zigbeeEventTrackerCollectFirmwareUpgradeFailureEvents
methods.description: Returns a list of firmware upgrade failure events, caller must free.

methods.name: zigbeeEventTrackerCollectChannelEnergyScanStats
methods.description: Returns a list of channel energy scan statistics, caller must free.

methods.name: destroyDeviceAttributeItem
methods.description: Frees memory for a device attribute item.

methods.name: destroyDeviceRejoinItem
methods.description: Frees memory for a device rejoin item.

methods.name: destroyDeviceUpgFailureItem
methods.description: Frees memory for a device upgrade failure item.

methods.name: shutDownEventTracker
methods.description: Cleans up and shuts down the event tracker system.
